    def transform(self, X: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
        X.index= pd.to_datetime(X.index)
        X.index= [datetime.replace(hour=12) for datetime in X.index] 
        X.index= X.index - pd.Timedelta(hours=2)
        X.index.name= "date"
        return X
